map.覆盖力学、热学、电磁学等分类的物理公式，选定公式后填入已知变量，自动求解未知量并: It covers physics formulas across mechanics, thermodynamics and electromagnetism; after choosing a formula you fill in the known variables and it solves for the unknown while showing the substitution, suited to homework, lab data processing and engineering estimates.
map.公式按力学 / 热学 / 电磁等分类组织: Formulas are organized by categories such as mechanics, thermodynamics and electromagnetism
map.选定公式填已知量，自动解未知量: Pick a formula, fill in the known values, and it solves for the unknown
map.展示代入数值后的推导步骤: Show the derivation steps after substituting the values
map.常见公式附适用条件与单位: Common formulas with their applicable conditions and units
map.纯前端运行: Runs entirely in the front end
map.课后作业：代入已知量求速度、力、功等: Homework: substitute known values to solve for speed, force, work, etc.
map.实验报告：用公式反推缺失物理量: Lab report: back out the missing physical quantity with the formula
map.工程估算：快速验算设计参数: Engineering estimate: quickly check design parameters
map.选择物理分类（力学 / 热学 / 电磁等）: Choose a physics category (mechanics / thermodynamics / electromagnetism, etc.)
map.点击具体公式进入计算面板: Click a specific formula to open the calculation panel
map.填入已知变量，留空待求量: Fill in the known variables and leave the unknown blank
map.点击「计算」得到结果与步骤: Click Calculate to get the result and the steps
map.未知量留空、其余填全，工具才知求解哪个: Leave the unknown blank and fill everything else, otherwise the tool cannot tell what to solve for
map.单位统一再代入，混用会差 10^3 量级: Convert to consistent units before substituting; mixing them introduces an error of order 10^3
map.带角度的量注意用度还是弧度: For quantities with an angle, check whether you need degrees or radians
map.结果带步骤，建议逐项核对代入: The result includes steps; check each substitution item by item
map.公式分类里找不到？: Cannot find it in the formula categories?
map.可用搜索或换近义词；非常用公式建议先用分类浏览。: Use search or a synonym; for uncommon formulas browse by category first.
map.步骤和教材不一致？: Do the steps differ from the textbook?
map.多半是单位或符号定义不同，按步骤核对变量即可。: It is usually a unit or symbol definition difference; check the variables step by step.
